title: After one C-section: repeat surgery vs vaginal birth (%)

source.name: Vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) rate
source.publisher: CDC National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS) / March of Dimes PeriStats

notes: NCHS reports the 2024 VBAC rate (share of women with a prior cesarean who deliver vaginally) at 15.5 per 100 births, up from 11.3 per 100 in 2014 but still low. The repeat-cesarean share shown here (84.5%) is the direct arithmetic complement of the published VBAC rate (100 - 15.5).
